evidence.notes: Trigger-time SObject.addError accepts an exception object and escapeHtml flag, and surfaces a local DML error.
Trigger-time SObject.addError accepts a Schema.SObjectField token and records the named field on a local DML error.
Trigger-time SObject.addError accepts a Schema.SObjectField token plus escapeHtml flag and records the named field on a local DML error.

source.content: trigger AccountAddErrorTokenOverloads on Account (before insert) { Schema.SObjectField nameField = Account.SObjectType.getDescribe().fields.getMap().get('Name'); for (Account a : Trigger.new) { if (a.Name == 'Block') { a.addError(new DmlException('object bool'), false); a.addError(nameField, 'token message'); a.addError(nameField, 'token message escape', false); } } }

@isTest private class DataRuntimeSObjectAddErrorTokenOverloadsTest { @isTest static void tokenAndObjectAddErrorOverloadsRun() { Database.SaveResult result = Database.insert(new Account(Name = 'Block'), false); System.assert(!result.isSuccess()); List<Database.Error> errors = result.getErrors(); System.assertEquals(3, errors.size()); System.assertEquals('object bool', errors[0].getMessage()); System.assertEquals('token message', errors[1].getMessage()); System.assertEquals('Name', errors[1].getFields()[0]); System.assertEquals('token message escape', errors[2].getMessage()); System.assertEquals('Name', errors[2].getFields()[0]); } }
